Figure 1:Work2Skill framework: WorkRecorder, WorkDemo-350,
and Agentic Skill Induction.

Figure 2:Overview of Work2Skill. WorkRecorder aligns human GUI actions with
visual and available accessibility evidence to build WorkDemo-350. An agent
inspects evidence on demand and revises reusable skills for downstream GUI
execution. Downstream evaluation compares these skills with guidance from
the fixed workflows of ShowUI-Aloha and Demo2Tutorial.

Figure 3:Human GUI experience collection with WorkRecorder. A demonstrated workflow (left) is captured and reviewed through the recorder interface (center), then organized into an evidence episode with task metadata, action traces, and available multimodal evidence (right).

Figure 6:Execution trajectories (top) and rubric outcomes (bottom) for a TableFind
reservation with fallbacks, using GPT-5.5 with each method’s extracted
guidance. Both baselines leave fallback handling and persistence checks
incomplete (55/10055/100); Work2Skill satisfies all eight requirements
(100/100100/100). AppendixF.2provides the detailed rubric
and execution analysis.
